:::{#def-ppv}
#### Positive predictive value (PPV)

The **positive predictive value** of a diagnostic test is the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability)
that the person tested has the disease ($D$),
given that the test is [positive](#def-positive-classification) ($\posclass$):

$$\text{PPV} \eqdef \Pr(D \mid \posclass)$$ {#eq-ppv}

Source: @wikipedia_positive_and_negative_predictive_values.
:::
